Args:
set -eu &&     export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive &&     printf '%s
' 'deb [arch=arm64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg] https://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports noble-security main' > /tmp/kubeview-apt-security.list &&     apt_safe() { apt-get -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/tmp/kubeview-apt-security.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o Acquire::Languages=none -o Acquire::Retries=0 -o Acquire::https::Timeout=15 -o Acquire::By-Hash=true -o Acquire::AllowInsecureRepositories=false -o Acquire::AllowDowngradeToInsecureRepositories=false "$@"; };     apt_safe update &&     plan="$(apt_safe --simulate --no-install-recommends --only-upgrade --no-remove install apt=2.8.4ubuntu0.1 libapt-pkg6.0t64=2.8.4ubuntu0.1)" &&     printf '%s
' "$plan" &&     printf '%s
' "$plan" | while IFS=' ' read -r action package rest; do if [ "$action" = Inst ]; then case "$package" in apt|libapt-pkg6.0t64) ;; *) printf 'Unexpected package change: %s
' "$package" >&2; exit 81 ;; esac; elif [ "$action" = Remv ]; then exit 82; fi; done &&     apt_safe -y --no-install-recommends --only-upgrade --no-remove install apt=2.8.4ubuntu0.1 libapt-pkg6.0t64=2.8.4ubuntu0.1 &&     dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}	${Version}
' apt libapt-pkg6.0t64 &&     dpkg --compare-versions "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' apt)" ge 2.8.4ubuntu0.1 &&     dpkg --compare-versions "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' libapt-pkg6.0t64)" ge 2.8.4ubuntu0.1 &&     rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /var/cache/apt/archives/*.deb /tmp/kubeview-apt-security.list
